description: Curated symbol addresses for strict fixup verification (tools/symbols.py). cs = CS offset (file offset - 0x200); ds = DGROUP offset (DS:0 = file 0x256D0); far = load-module paragraph:offset of a far data segment. Library _TEXT publics are derived automatically from KNOWN_LIBRARY regions, and the publics of the C units (src/*.C) and assembly modules (src/asm) from their placed objects (tools/verify_sources.py); neither is listed here. What remains are objects not (yet) built from source: the far data segments and the data-only module after the assembly.

_main.evidence: C0S calls it (call at file 0x2FC, disp 0x013A); see tests/test_coordinates.py

N_OVERFLOW@.evidence: target of the `call` in every -N stack check (cmp [___brklvl],sp; jb +3; call N_OVERFLOW@) across all C functions; tail-jumps into C0S

___brklvl.evidence: operand of `cmp word ptr [0x9a],sp` in every -N stack check; TCC emits it as an EXTDEF ___brklvl fixup

_g_vga_palette.evidence: set_video_mode (F_6D64) loads all 256 DAC registers (INT 10h AX=1012h) from DS:0x143A; first object of the data-only module after tiles.asm's _DATA (word pad at DS 0x1439), followed by g_levels at DS 0x173A (docs/data-layout.md)

_g_demo_bank.evidence: init_game_once (F_519B): g_demo_data = MK_FP(0x0B31,0), MZ relocation; DATA_DEMOS (docs/data-layout.md 5.1)
